title: IIM Common Admission Test CAT Admission Apply Online Form 2026 Date Extended
postName: Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 – MBA / PGDM Online Registration
vacancyDetails: National-level entrance for MBA/PGP and other management programmes at IIMs and participating B-schools across India
qualification: Bachelor’s degree with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA (45% for SC/ST/PwD) from a recognised university; final-year students may also apply as per CAT rules
ageLimit: No upper age limit for CAT
selectionProcess: CAT Computer Based Test → IIM shortlisting (WAT/PI/GD as per institute) → Final admission offers by participating institutes
documentsRequired: Valid email & mobile, photo, signature, category certificate (if applicable), PwD certificate (if applicable), academic details, photo ID for exam day
howToApply:
1. Visit https://iimcat.ac.in
2. Click Register for CAT 2026
3. Create profile with name, DOB, email and mobile
4. Fill personal, academic and work details; choose up to 5 test cities
5. Upload photo and signature as per specifications
6. Pay fee online and submit; download confirmation

courseDetails: Post Graduate Programmes in Management (PGP) and Fellowship Programmes in Management (FPM / PhD).
shortDescription: IIM CAT 2026 registration deadline has been extended to 22 September 2026 up to 5:00 PM. The CAT exam will be held on 29 November 2026.
content:
Indian Institute of Management (IIM) has released the Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 admission notification. The CAT 2026 application deadline has been extended to 22/09/2026 up to 05:00 PM.

CAT is the national-level entrance examination for admission to PGP, MBA and related management programmes at IIMs and participating institutes.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 03/08/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 22/09/2026 up to 05:00 PM
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 22/09/2026
  • Admit Card: 04/11/2026
  • Exam Date: 29/11/2026
  • Result: January 2027

Eligibility

Bachelor’s degree in any stream with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA. The minimum is 45% for SC/ST candidates. Check the official information bulletin for final-year and category-specific rules.

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: ₹2,700
  • SC / ST / PH: ₹1,350

Pay the fee through debit card, credit card, net banking or the prescribed e-challan mode.

Courses

  • Post Graduate Programmes in Management (PGP)
  • Fellowship Programmes in Management (FPM) / PhD

Apply only through the official CAT portal and read the information brochure before submitting the form.

faqs.question: What is CAT 2026 used for?
faqs.answer: CAT is a computer-based entrance examination used by IIMs and participating business schools for MBA, PGP and related management programme admissions.

faqs.question: What is the CAT 2026 academic eligibility?
faqs.answer: The listing states that candidates generally need a bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks, or 45% for SC, ST and PwD candidates, subject to the official CAT rules.

faqs.question: How many test cities can be selected?
faqs.answer: The application instructions on this page allow candidates to choose up to five preferred test cities, subject to the official form and availability.

faqs.question: Where should CAT registration be completed?
faqs.answer: Register only through the official CAT portal at iimcat.ac.in and save the application number and confirmation page.
